target.role: Managing Director, Portfolio Analysis and Strategic Initiatives

summary: Portfolio and market risk analytics specialist bringing ~7 years of institutional risk experience to ATB Financial's Managing Director, Portfolio Analysis and Strategic Initiatives mandate. Holds delegated sign-off at Moody's Analytics over valuation, sensitivity, and balance-sheet risk outputs for institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement, including portfolio-level risk aggregation review and senior-stakeholder risk commentary. Designed an enterprise multi-scenario stress and cash flow projection engine, ran VaR/CVaR portfolio optimization and risk decomposition at Ortec Finance, and replaced manual spreadsheet workflows with Python pipelines. CFA charterholder, dual MSc, model governance committee member.
core_skills: Banking Book Interest-Rate & Balance Sheet Risk

roles.title: Asst. Director, Modelling Services (Investment & ALM Risk)

sections.heading: Top-of-House Portfolio Analysis & Executive Reporting
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and balance sheet risk outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative), independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions before production release.
Review aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics feeding downstream ALM and capital processes.

Produce analytical summaries and risk reporting for senior stakeholders covering interest-rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance sheet sensitivities, translating quantitative output into committee-ready commentary.

sections.heading: Stress Testing, Scenario Design & Market Risk Analysis
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenario analysis across multi-year horizons.
Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year) enabling funding optimization, refinancing risk assessment, and asset-allocation decisions.

Oversee interest-rate and duration analysis under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks across banking book exposures, aligned with IRRBB standards analogous to Basel / OSFI B-12, and embed behavioral cash flow, prepayment, and macro stress overlays.

sections.heading: Risk Infrastructure, Data Pipelines & Governance
bullets: Validate derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, cross-checking sensitivity consistency at portfolio-level ALM aggregates and escalating outputs lacking economic defensibility.
Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation, and auditability controls.
Serve on the model governance committee, contributing to methodology review, benchmarking and documentation standards, and model-performance assessment for client-delivered analytics.

Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, and anomaly detection, cutting development cycle time an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe DB (risk & ALM analytics) and PFaroe PM (portfolio management) platforms.

Acted as technical liaison between client investment teams and product/development functions, scoping requirements into development requests, validating model outputs post-deployment, and migrating all assigned accounts off the legacy Calypso environment.

roles.title: Senior Consultant, IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 regulatory transformation projects for Canadian and international insurers, aligning regulatory requirements with system implementation and financial reporting frameworks.
Coordinated actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and program-management functions on milestone delivery, governance documentation, and regulatory-readiness processes.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition, contribution-to-risk budgeting, and near-optimal frontier analysis to test allocation robustness.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators quantifying interest-rate risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments.
Delivered ALM studies for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors, analyzing funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance sheet risk exposures.
Conducted cash flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk for international institutional clients.

Presented portfolio analysis and stress-test findings to pension-fund investment committees on-site, including a three-plan university pension merger where a team of three developed and validated the funding-policy model.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
